collection.description: Put it to your ear, the trader said, and listen to the sea, and turn it the way the spiral goes: you get younger.

ask.text:
A trader has given (name) a spiral shell, cream and brown, that (he/she) says comes from an island where nobody grows old. "Put it to your ear," the trader said, "and listen to the sea, and turn it the way the spiral goes: you get younger. Turn it the other way: you get older. Only once, though. The shell only turns once."
(Name) is holding it to (his/her) ear. The sea inside is very loud. (He/She) can't remember which way the trader said the spiral goes. Should (name) turn it to the left, or to the right?

c1o1.text: (Name) feels it from (his/her) feet up: the ache going out of (his/her) knees, the stiffness out of (his/her) back, the weight off (his/her) shoulders. Ten years, gone like water down a drain. When (he/she) looks in the water jar, the face is (his/hers) from ten years ago. The shell has gone silent, and stays silent forever after. (Name) keeps it on the shelf anyway.

c1o2.text: (Name) feels it from (his/her) head down: the grey coming into (his/her) hair, the lines into (his/her) face, the creak into (his/her) knees. Ten years in a moment. (He/She) sits down heavily. "Left," (he/she) says, to nobody. "It was right. Of course it was right." The shell is silent now. (Name) throws it in the sea.

c1.text: (Name) turns the shell slowly to the left. The sea inside rushes, roars, and then goes very quiet...

c2o1.text: The shell, apparently, was only half sure what it was doing. (Name)'s body stays exactly the same age, knees and all. But (his/her) face, in the water jar, is younger by years, bright and smooth. "Not that way," the shell said. (Name) decides it was being modest.

c2o2.text: Nothing happens. The sea inside the shell goes quiet, and stays quiet. (Name) is the same age and the same face as before. It was, (he/she) decides, just a shell, and the trader was just a trader, and the voice was just the wind. (He/She) keeps the shell anyway, and the children listen to it, and say they can still hear the voice.

c2.text: (Name) turns the shell slowly to the right. The sea inside rushes and roars, and then a voice inside it says, very clearly, "Oh, not that way"...
